body.name: Local-subsequence separately anchored endpoint energy
body.construction: For each finite root-\(m_\ell\) knot cluster, translate one anchor to zero, retain the known within-cell differences and the unresolved cross-cell translations, replace each empirical knot by \(d_{jtr}+Z_{jtr}\), retain the population anchor at \(d_{jtr}\), and set \(\Psi_t(d,Z)=-\tfrac12\sum_{q,q'}b_{tq}b_{tq'}|s_{tq}(d,Z)-s_{tq'}(d,Z)|\), summing over clusters.
